name: @obvia/collections
description: Immutable, fluent and deeply typed collections for TypeScript.

scripts.clean: bun -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.build: bun run clean && bun build ./src/index.ts ./src/collection.ts ./src/collect.ts --root ./src --outdir ./dist --target browser --format esm --sourcemap linked --packages external
scripts.test:runtime: bun test tests/unit tests/behavior tests/guards tests/contracts tests/properties tests/performance
scripts.test:coverage: bun -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('coverage', { recursive: true, force: true })" && bun test --coverage tests/unit tests/behavior tests/guards tests/contracts tests/properties tests/performance
scripts.test: bun run test:runtime && bun run test:types

author: Selçuk Çukur <selcukcukur@outlook.com.tr>
